api_tool_definition.description: Preview/start a bounded PageSpeed-only enrichment of supplied URLs, or status/read/cancel/export an existing API-only job. Our application does not crawl supplied websites; Google PageSpeed may fetch them remotely. Explicit start can send provider requests. Keys are resolved only from a selected server credential profile, never tool arguments.
api_tool_definition.name: spider_api_enrichment
